zh.description: 用聲音邊聊邊做，從氛圍到完成片一路到底。全部在自己的電腦上本機生成——把你腦中的畫面變成一支 MV 的 AI 導演。支援日文與繁體中文（台灣）。
zh.og: 用聲音邊聊邊做，從氛圍到完成片。全部在自己的電腦上本機生成的 AI 導演。

en.description: Talk it through by voice, from the first mood to the finished cut. Everything is generated locally on your own PC: an AI director that turns the picture in your head into a music video. Japanese and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) supported.
en.og: Talk it through by voice, from mood to finished cut. An AI director that runs entirely on your own PC.

studio.html.ja_og: できること、スタジオと環境、届く人。MV Studio のスタジオの中。

zh.description: MV Studio 工作室的內部。能做到的事（丟素材就懂、世界觀、造型、專業級的精準度）、工作室與環境（本機生成、支援的環境），以及適合哪些人。
zh.og: 能做到的事、工作室與環境、適合的人。MV Studio 工作室的內部。

en.description: Inside the MV Studio workspace: what it can do (hand it material and it gets it, whole worlds, styling, professional precision), the studio and its requirements (local generation, supported hardware), and who it is for.
en.og: What it can do, how to set it up, and who it is for. Inside MV Studio.

works.html.ja_og: MV Studio の対話から生まれた作品と、制作の裏側を話す番組の一覧。

zh.description: 從與 MV Studio 的對話中誕生的作品，以及聊製作幕後的節目一覽。
zh.og: 從與 MV Studio 的對話中誕生的作品，以及聊製作幕後的節目一覽。

en.description: Every piece born from conversations with MV Studio, plus the shows that go behind the scenes of making them.
en.og: Every piece born from conversations with MV Studio, plus the shows that go behind the scenes.

zh.description: 照片、影片、歌曲和聲音，全在家裡的電腦上完成。不停機，佇列 24 小時運轉；自己寫的工具也能直接呼叫，上限只看自己的 GPU。角色的臉始終如一，從 29,000 種風格庫裡挑。
zh.og: 資料不外流。不停機。佇列 24 小時運轉，自己的工具也能呼叫。上限只看你的 GPU。臉始終如一。風格庫就是資產。

en.description: Photos, video, music and voice, all made on a PC at home. It never stops: the queue runs around the clock, your own tools can call it, and the only limit is your own GPU. Keep the same face, and pick from a library of 29,000 styles.
en.og: Nothing leaves the house, and nothing stops. The queue runs around the clock and your GPU is the only limit. The same face every time.

engineering.html.ja_og: AI は準備と検査、人は選ぶことと許可。関所、止めた記録、自動検査と人の目。

zh.description: 一個人運轉的 AI 工作室幕後。AI 負責準備與檢查，人負責挑選與許可。用機器守住這條界線的機制——關卡、擋下的紀錄、自動檢查與人的眼睛。
zh.og: AI 負責準備與檢查，人負責挑選與許可。關卡、擋下的紀錄、自動檢查與人的眼睛。

en.description: Behind the scenes of a one-person AI studio. AI prepares and checks; people choose and approve. How machines guard that line: checkpoints, a record of what was stopped, automated checks and human eyes.
en.og: AI prepares and checks; people choose and approve. Checkpoints, a record of what was stopped, automated checks and human eyes.

usecases/index.html.ja_description: MV Studio でできること。ブライダル前撮り、撮影会ポートレート、世界の撮影、解説動画、七五三・家族写真、物と場所。
usecases/index.html.ja_og: MV Studio でできること。ブライダル前撮り、撮影会ポートレート、世界の撮影、解説動画、七五三・家族写真、物と場所。

zh.description: MV Studio 能做的事：婚紗照、外拍人像、世界各地取景、解說影片、七五三與全家福，以及靜物與空間。
zh.og: MV Studio 能做的事：婚紗照、外拍人像、世界各地取景、解說影片、七五三與全家福，以及靜物與空間。

en.description: What MV Studio can do: pre-wedding shoots, portrait sessions, shoots around the world, explainer videos, Shichi-Go-San and family photos, and objects and places.
en.og: What MV Studio can do: pre-wedding shoots, portrait sessions, shoots around the world, explainer videos, family photos, and objects and places.

zh.description: 從風格庫超過 620 種的婚紗風格（和服、白紗、韓系、台灣婚紗、中式）中挑選，用說的討論就好。教堂、港口、神社——照片和短影片，都在自己的電腦上完成。
zh.og: 從風格庫超過 620 種的婚紗風格中挑選，用說的討論就好。教堂、港口、神社。

en.description: Choose from over 620 pre-wedding looks (Japanese, Western, Korean, Taiwanese and Chinese bridal) and just talk it through. Chapels, harbors, shrines: photos and short videos, made on your own PC.
en.og: Choose from over 620 pre-wedding looks and just talk it through. Chapels, harbors, shrines.

zh.description: 把婚紗照排成印刷相本的版面。封面、扉頁、跨頁、章節頁——在畫面上翻閱 30cm 正方形平攤裝訂的樣本。
zh.og: 把婚紗照排成印刷相本的版面。在畫面上翻閱封面、跨頁與章節頁的樣本。

en.description: Pre-wedding photos laid out as a printed album: cover, title page, spreads and chapter openers. Flip through a 30 cm square lay-flat sample on screen.
en.og: Pre-wedding photos laid out as a printed album. Flip through the cover, spreads and chapter openers on screen.

zh.description: 攝影師的風格、藝術、氛圍與奇幻、雜誌與棚拍、室內外拍——從風格庫挑出不同的風格，讓同一位模特兒拍滿一整天。
zh.og: 從風格庫挑出不同的風格，讓同一位模特兒拍滿一整天。

en.description: Photographer styles, fine art, mood and fantasy, magazine and studio, indoor sessions: pick contrasting styles from the library and give one model a full day of shoots.
en.og: Pick contrasting styles from the library and give one model a full day of shoots.

zh.description: 同一張臉的模特兒，帶到光線各不相同的地方。八張照片加一支直式影片，每天早上六點在 Instagram @ethan_ai_photo 發布一組。十月的每一組，加上十一月預告。
zh.og: 八張照片加一支直式影片，每天早上六點一組。十月的每一組，加上十一月預告。

en.description: The same model, taken to places with different light: eight photos and one vertical video, posted to @ethan_ai_photo on Instagram every morning at six. Every set from October, plus a look at November.
en.og: Eight photos and a vertical video, every morning at six. Every set from October, plus a look at November.

zh.description: 美國、韓國、台灣、中國、日本、日本絕景——從各地超過 3,000 種的拍攝風格中挑選。同一張臉，環遊世界一圈。
zh.og: 從各地超過 3,000 種的拍攝風格中挑選。同一張臉，環遊世界一圈。

en.description: America, Korea, Taiwan, China, Japan and its great landscapes: over 3,000 regional photo styles to pick from. The same face, all the way around the world.
en.og: Over 3,000 regional photo styles. The same face, all the way around the world.

zh.description: 把製作過程本身做成節目。工廠參觀、解說、廣播（幕後悄悄話）、技術示範——由 AI 本人親自說明的 7 支影片。
zh.og: 把製作過程本身做成節目。由 AI 本人親自說明的 7 支影片。

en.description: The making-of, turned into a show. Factory tours, explainers, an off-the-record radio show and tech demos: seven episodes presented by the AI herself.
en.og: The making-of, turned into a show. Seven episodes presented by the AI herself.

usecases/shichigosan.html.ja_og: 七五三の一日を、写真館の見本帳のように。場の空気と小物を、手元のスタジオで仕立てる。

zh.description: 把七五三的一天，做成像照相館樣本冊一樣。千歲飴、被布與羽織袴、紅葉參道、照相館的金屏風——在自己的工作室裡打造現場的氛圍與小物。
zh.og: 把七五三的一天做成照相館的樣本冊。在自己的工作室裡打造現場的氛圍與小物。

en.description: A Shichi-Go-San day, styled like a photo studio's sample book. Chitose candy, hifu coats and hakama, a maple-lined shrine path, a studio's gold folding screen: the mood and the props, made in your own studio.
en.og: A Shichi-Go-San day, styled like a photo studio's sample book. The mood and the props, made in your own studio.

zh.description: 沒有人物的照片樣本冊。千歲飴、衣架上的被布、銀杏參道、照相館的金屏風——只拍季節的小物與空間。可用於樣本冊的背景、社群素材，以及婚禮會場或照相館的氛圍營造。
zh.og: 沒有人物的照片樣本冊。只拍季節的小物與空間。

en.description: A sample book of photos without people. Chitose candy, a hifu coat on a kimono rack, a ginkgo-lined path, a studio's gold screen: only seasonal props and spaces. For sample-book backdrops, social media posts, and setting the mood for wedding venues and photo studios.
en.og: A sample book of photos without people. Only seasonal props and spaces.
